crossRefs.note: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…
One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
crossRefs.keyword: an excellent spirit. or, a cool spirit

crossRefs.note: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
crossRefs.keyword: an excellent spirit. or, a cool spirit

crossRefs.note: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
crossRefs.keyword: an excellent spirit. or, a cool spirit

translations.web: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
translations.bsb: A man of knowledge restrains his words, and a man of understanding maintains a calm spirit.
translations.kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
translations.asv: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that is of a cool spirit is a man of understanding.
